// Magic byte detection cho image upload — tranh attacker gui file sai format
// voi MIME string gia mao (vd SVG co embed JS nhung claim image/jpeg).

export type ImageMime = 'image/jpeg' | 'image/png' | 'image/webp'

// Tra ve MIME dung theo magic bytes, null neu khong phai image whitelist
export function detectImageMime(buf: Buffer): ImageMime | null {
  if (!buf || buf.length < 12) return null

  // JPEG: FF D8 FF
  if (buf[0] === 0xff && buf[1] === 0xd8 && buf[2] === 0xff) return 'image/jpeg'

  // PNG: 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A
  if (
    buf[0] === 0x89 && buf[1] === 0x50 && buf[2] === 0x4e && buf[3] === 0x47
    && buf[4] === 0x0d && buf[5] === 0x0a && buf[6] === 0x1a && buf[7] === 0x0a
  ) return 'image/png'

  // WebP: "RIFF....WEBP"
  if (
    buf[0] === 0x52 && buf[1] === 0x49 && buf[2] === 0x46 && buf[3] === 0x46
    && buf[8] === 0x57 && buf[9] === 0x45 && buf[10] === 0x42 && buf[11] === 0x50
  ) return 'image/webp'

  return null
}

import { createHash } from 'crypto'

// Refresh token luu dang SHA-256 hex cua raw token (ULID high-entropy 128 bit).
// Tranh bcrypt O(N) scan truoc day — gio lookup unique index O(1).
export function hashRefreshToken(raw: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex')
}
